name: Crispy rice with kho veal
summary: Crispy rice with kho veal. Báo Quốc tế names cơm cháy bò tơ kho. Tuổi Trẻ names bò tơ kho sả eaten with crispy rice, and later cơm cháy bò kho sả.
origin: Củ Chi. Both names are veal kho with crispy rice. The wording is not the same, so both stay.
howToEat: Báo Quốc tế lists cơm cháy bò tơ kho and does not give the steps.
Tuổi Trẻ says bò tơ kho sả eaten with cơm cháy, and also cơm cháy bò kho sả. It calls the boiled rice-paper roll the older plate.
No price was printed. Check on arrival. The hour is Check on arrival.
where: No street was printed. Check on arrival
